description: This file defines the Vehicle entity class for the Java backend in a fleet management system, including its fields, annotations for persistence, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Vehicle
classes.description: A JPA entity representing vehicle data with attributes such as VIN, license plate, make, model, year, and status.

methods.name: getLicensePlate
methods.description: Returns the license plate of the vehicle.

methods.name: getMake
methods.description: Returns the make of the vehicle.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the model of the vehicle.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing year of the vehicle.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the vehicle.

methods.name: setLicensePlate
methods.description: Sets the license plate of the vehicle.

methods.name: setMake
methods.description: Sets the make of the vehicle.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Sets the model of the vehicle.

methods.name: setYear
methods.description: Sets the manufacturing year of the vehicle.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the vehicle.
